description: Fixture rows for the implemented integrateDiffuseSkyAirlight stage contract. Rows cover low/high-tau fallback behavior, the aerosol-aware mode id, and aerosol/flat-geometry diagnostics for the bounded diffuse sky airlight approximation.

expectedComparisonPolicy.nonnumeric: Exact structural comparison for object, array, string, boolean, and null expected values. Numeric spectral values use each datum's tolerance rule.

expectations.quantity: low optical depth diffuse sky airlight suppression

reference.title: PBRT v4, Volume Scattering Integrators
reference.locator: Volume scattering integrators distinguish simple verified volume paths from fuller volumetric transport with repeated scattering events.
reference.derivationSummary: The fixture preserves the first lost-transmittance higher-order proxy under the proposed diffuse sky airlight stage name. With max visible tau below the activation threshold, smoothstep(1, 8, 0.4) = 0, so no approximate diffuse sky airlight is added.

supportingReferences.title: libRadtran basic usage

supportingReferences.derivationSummary: Supports keeping a separate diffuse sky airlight component rather than hiding it in color conversion or direct single scattering.

sourceSpectrum.derivation: Controlled source spectrum for the renamed diffuse sky airlight proxy fixture.

mode.derivation: Local stage contract: the stage uses the aerosol-aware lost-transmittance haze-lift mode; when aerosol optical depth is absent, aerosol participation is zero and the arithmetic reduces to the first proxy.

activation.derivation: smoothstep edge0=1, edge1=8 clamps t=(0.4-1)/(8-1) below 0, so activation is 0.

skyAirlightRadianceByWavelength.derivation: source[w] * (1 - viewTransmittance[w]) * activation * strength = 0 for both wavelengths because activation is 0.

renderedSinglePlusSkyAirlightByWavelengt.derivation: canonical single scattering plus zero sky airlight: [0.1 + 0, 0.2 + 0].

expectations.independence: The expected values are hand arithmetic from the named proxy and external transport-order rationale; they do not call the stage implementation.

reference.derivationSummary: The row pins the renamed first mode for missing higher-order sky airlight: activate from max visible optical depth, use Beer-Lambert view transmittance as the surviving direct fraction, and add a bounded fraction of lost source light as diffuse sky airlight.

aerosolOpticalDepthByWavelength.derivation: The aerosol/Mie optical depth is copied from viewOpticalDepth.pathEnd.speciesOpticalDepth.mie.cumulativeOpticalDepthByWavelength.

aerosolOpticalDepthFractionByWavelength.derivation: Per wavelength aerosol fraction is mieTau / totalTau: [4/7.2, 2/3.1].

tauRegime.derivation: Local diagnostic contract: max total tau 7.2 is above the high-tau warning threshold of 5 and below the extreme threshold of 10.

flatGeometryLimitPolicy.derivation: Local flat-geometry design contract: diffuse sky airlight must be bounded for near-parallel flat rays because optical depth can continue accumulating.

expectations.independence: The expected diagnostics are direct arithmetic over fixture-owned species optical-depth arrays plus named local regime thresholds; they do not use the stage implementation.
